# ARD Parameters & Filters — Master List

**Generated by:** Grok  
**Date:** May 17, 2026  
**Purpose:** Complete reference of all parameters and filters developed across the entire conversation.

---

## 1. Core Sequence Parameters

| # | Parameter | Description |
|---|-----------|-------------|
| 1 | Raw Source | Original input, wording, and emotional tone |
| 2 | Pattern | Repeating structures, symbols, or behaviors |
| 3 | Intent | Surface + Hidden + Protected intent |
| 4 | Event | What actually happened or is happening |
| 5 | Category | Classification (Human / Structural / Symbolic / Systemic / etc.) |
| 6 | Definition Version | Current version of the definition (v0.1, v1.0, etc.) |
| 7 | Fact Check | Level of verification (Fact / Claim / Inference / Speculation / Unknown) |
| 8 | Risk Flag | Type and level of risk (Legal / Public / Private / Drift / Distortion) |
| 9 | Master Link | Connection to other parameters or engines |
| 10 | Output Engine | Final structured output format |

| # | Filter / Gate | Description | Category |
|---|---------------|-------------|----------|

| 34 | Doubt Engine | Systematically attacks conclusions | Depth & Penetration |

| 36 | Critical Logic Wall | Four walls: Data / Choice / Courage / Identity | Control & Governance |

| 45 | Identity Compression Alert | Warns when oversimplification is occurring | Depth & Penetration |
| 46 | Synthetic Leakage Guard | Tracks how far synthetic elements have influenced output | Risk & Verification |

## 4. Categories Summary

| Category | Purpose | Key Parameters/Filters |
|----------|---------|------------------------|
| **Core Sequence** | Maintains the fundamental flow of thinking | Raw Source, Pattern, Intent, Sequence Fidelity, Chronological Trace |
| **Risk & Verification** | Detects danger, distortion, and uncertainty | Risk Vector, Drift Flag, Verification Level, Truth Pressure Test, Double Anchor Protocol |
| **Control & Governance** | Maintains human authority and system integrity | Pre-Loop Self-Check, Public-Private Boundary, Critical Logic Wall, Human Halt Gate, Vertical Descent Lock |
| **Depth & Penetration** | Forces deep and honest analysis | Noise Stripper, Owl Gate, Doubt Engine, Witness Node, Empty Gap Excavator |
| **Generative & Creative** | Enables invention while maintaining control | Synthetic Fuel Injector (Caged), Generative Potential, New Language Potential |
| **Termination & Safety** | Prevents infinite loops and burnout | Termination Governor, Result Stop Rule, Memory Loop Breaker, Long-term Usability |

---

## 5. Master Rules (Non-Negotiable)

- Human authority is absolute at all times.
- Every synthetic output must be tagged **[SYNTHETIC]** until promoted by evidence.
- Non-resolution is a valid terminal state.
- Raw source must be preserved before any rewriting.
- Public and private outputs must be clearly separated.
- Every output must carry a falsifier ("What would disprove this?").
- The system must name avoidance when it detects it.
- Mystery and Invention categories are protected.

---

**End of Master List**

This file contains all parameters and filters developed during the conversation. It can be used as a reference or imported into future versions of the engine.
